column1: # Globals the offline client-boot harness does not model, read at load by the
# shipped graph of each flavor. tools/tests/client_boot_smoke.lua diffs the
# live set against this file: a global that appears here is a reviewed read,
# a new one fails the smoke, and a row nothing reads any more fails it too.
# Flavors: * means every flavor the matrix plus WoW Forever covers; otherwise a
# comma-separated subset. Kind groups the rows: unit, api, namespace, constant,
# table and secret are Blizzard surfaces the harness answers with a permissive
# stub; frame is a Blizzard UI frame; thirdparty is an addon MSUF detects;
# defect marks a read that is a bug in the addon, reported and not fixed here.
